name: codex-sync
description: Privately share user-authored Codex Skills between Macs as a conflict-safe two-way union with reviewed plans, receipts, and snapshots.

interface.shortDescription: Private, plan-bound Skills sharing between Macs
interface.longDescription: Share user-authored Codex Skills as a two-way union through your own private shared folder. Device rules and AGENTS.md are excluded by default. Store identity, reviewed Plan IDs, handoff receipts, snapshots, conflict preservation, and strict exclusions protect each transfer; no synchronized content is sent to the developer.
defaultPrompt: Create a Codex Sync Store in my private shared folder and show me its Store ID.
Join my existing Codex Sync Store only if its Store ID matches.
Show status as JSON, explain the plan, and apply only the approved Plan ID.
Verify the previous Mac's receipt before syncing this Mac.
Show snapshot history and preview a restore without changing files.
